q: Where can I rent a holiday cottage on the Una River near Bihać?
a: Riverside houses and cottages near Bihać are mostly found in Lohovo, Pritoka and Grmuša. apartmanibihac.com lists twelve houses on the river, including Green River and Vikendica Unadom in Grmuša, Vila Enio in Lohovo and Vikendica Rekić in Pritoka. Send an enquiry through the website or via WhatsApp/Viber on +387 61 591 320, and the owner replies within 12 hours.

q: How much does a cottage on the Una River cost per night?
a: On apartmanibihac.com prices range from €25 to €100 per night for the whole property, depending on the house and the season. The most affordable places start at €25, or 50 KM, per night, which is roughly what a single room usually costs in Bihać. Houses with direct river access or a pool cost more, and July and August are the busiest months.

q: Is Lohovo a good place to stay on the Una River?
a: Lohovo is a quiet village on the Una south of Bihać, about 10 km from the town centre, or around 15 minutes by car. The river is slower and very clear here, so swimming and relaxing by the water are the main reasons people come. It suits families and anyone looking for a longer, peaceful break, and an entrance to Una National Park is close by.

q: Where is Pritoka and how far is it from Bihać town centre?
a: Pritoka is a riverside area on the Una right on the edge of Bihać, just a few minutes' drive from the centre. You sleep by the river, while shops, restaurants and the town's sights are close at hand. That makes Pritoka a good choice if you want a quiet house on the water without giving up the town.

q: How far is Grmuša from Bihać?
a: Grmuša lies about 20 km north-east of Bihać, on the Una. It is known as one of the main rafting spots on the river, and Una Olympic Rafting has its base in Grmuša/Salihovac, with a riverside restaurant. Cottages here are popular with rafting groups, but also with families looking for peace and quiet by the water.

q: Can you swim in the Una River right outside the cottage?
a: Yes, most houses we offer have their own access to the Una, so in summer you can swim right in front of the house. The water is clean and colder than the sea, which makes it refreshing even on the hottest days. Take care with children, as depth and current vary from spot to spot, especially after rain.

q: Which holiday homes on the Una River have a barbecue?
a: Houses with their own barbecue include Vikend kuća Bašić, Villa Džane, Vikendica Džane 2, Vikendica Karakaš, Villa Mekić and Villa Mekić 2. An outdoor barbecue by the river is one of the main reasons people choose a cottage over an apartment. If a barbecue matters to you, mention it in your enquiry on apartmanibihac.com and the owner will confirm the equipment.

q: Is there a holiday home on the Una River with a swimming pool?
a: Some houses around Bihać have a pool, but not many. In our selection it is Vila Enio in Lohovo, a house for 6 people with a pool and direct access to the Una, with one terrace above the river and another by the pool. For other houses, check the description or ask the owner in your enquiry.

q: Which cottage on the Una River is best for a large group?
a: For large groups the best fit is Villa Mekić 2, which sleeps up to 20 people across several apartments and has a terrace, barbecue and parking. For 9 to 10 people there are Villa Džane, Villa Mekić and Vikendica Karakaš. Villa Džane and Vikendica Džane 2 can also be booked together, so a bigger group can stay in one place.

q: Which holiday home on the Una River is good for a family with children?
a: Families are usually happiest in Lohovo and Pritoka, where the Una is calmer. Vila Enio in Lohovo has a pool and river access, while Vikendica Rekić in Pritoka sleeps up to 8 and is close to town. Always keep an eye on children by the water, as there are no lifeguards along the riverbank.

q: Are the riverside cottages on the Una quiet?
a: Yes, the houses on the Una in Lohovo, Pritoka and Grmuša are away from the bustle of town, and mostly all you hear is the river. On summer weekends some stretches of the river are busier with swimmers and rafting groups. If peace and quiet is your priority, ask us about dates outside July and August on WhatsApp/Viber +387 61 591 320.

q: Do I need a car if I stay in a cottage on the Una River?
a: For cottages outside town a car is almost essential, especially in Lohovo and Grmuša. From Lohovo it is about 15 minutes' drive to Bihać centre, and a little longer from Grmuša, which is around 20 km away. From Pritoka the town is only a few minutes' drive, so a car matters less there.

q: Are there shops near the holiday homes on the Una River?
a: The large supermarkets and the market are in Bihać, so it is easiest to stock up in town before heading to your cottage. From Pritoka the shops are a few minutes away, while from Lohovo and Grmuša you should allow for a short drive. Ask the owner on arrival where the nearest small shop is.

q: Are there mosquitoes on the Una River in summer?
a: As along most rivers, mosquitoes can appear in summer, especially in the evening and on warm nights after rain. The Una is fast and cold, so there are usually fewer than near still water, but it depends on the spot and the year. Bring insect repellent and close windows in the evening if they have no screens.

q: Can I rent a cottage on the Una River in winter?
a: Some houses on the Una welcome guests outside the summer season, but not all are equipped for winter. Before booking, ask the owner how the house is heated and whether the access road is kept clear in winter. Send your winter enquiry via apartmanibihac.com or to apartmaniubihacu@gmail.com.

q: What is winter like in a cottage on the Una River?
a: Winter on the Una is quiet, with mist over the river, occasional snow and no crowds. It is a good choice if you want peace, walks and evenings by the stove or heating. Expect cold nights and short days, so check the heating and road conditions before you arrive.

q: Which cottage on the Una River has a terrace over the water?
a: Green River and Vikendica Unadom in Grmuša, Vikendica Rekić in Pritoka and Vila Enio in Lohovo all have a terrace right above the Una. A terrace like that is the place for morning coffee and evenings listening to the river. Photos and descriptions of each house are on apartmanibihac.com.

q: What is the Japodska treehouse near Bihać?
a: Japodska kućica na drvetu (the Japodian treehouse) is a treehouse for 4 people set in the branches, with direct access to the Una. Underneath it there is a covered seating area, with a terrace alongside. It is one of the more unusual places to stay around Bihać and best suits couples and families who want to be close to nature.

q: How many people can stay at Villa Mekić 2?
a: Villa Mekić 2 sleeps up to 20 people across several apartments, making it one of the largest properties we offer. It has a terrace, barbecue, kitchen, living room, Wi-Fi and parking. It suits rafting groups, sports teams, wedding guests and large family gatherings.

q: Is a cottage in Grmuša a good base for rafting?
a: Yes, Grmuša is in the Una's rafting zone, and Una Olympic Rafting is based in Grmuša/Salihovac, with a riverside restaurant. The Green River and Unadom cottages there each sleep 6 + 2 people and have river access. We organise rafting for our guests with Una Olympic Rafting, so you can arrange it together with your accommodation.

q: How do I book a cottage on the Una River?
a: Choose a house on apartmanibihac.com and send an enquiry with your dates and the number of guests. The owner confirms availability, you get a reply within 12 hours and the booking confirmation arrives by email. You pay in cash on arrival, with no deposit required. If you prefer, you can pay an advance and get a discount for it; the amount and payment method are agreed when your enquiry is confirmed.

q: Is there a booking fee when reserving a cottage through apartmanibihac.com?
a: No, there is no booking fee on apartmanibihac.com because you deal directly with the owner. You pay in cash on arrival with no deposit required, and bed linen and final cleaning are included in the price. You will get a reply to your enquiry within 12 hours, and for questions we are on WhatsApp/Viber +387 61 591 320.

q: How far are the Una River cottages from Una National Park?
a: From Bihać it is roughly a 15-minute drive to the Una National Park entrance at Lohovo. A house in Lohovo is even closer to that entrance, which makes it a handy base for trips into the park. Štrbački buk, the park's main waterfall, is a longer drive, and part of the road is gravel.

q: How far is it from a cottage on the Una to the Plitvice Lakes?
a: Bihać is about 35 km from the Plitvice Lakes, a 35 to 40-minute drive via the Izačić border crossing. From Pritoka the drive is almost the same, while from Lohovo or Grmuša you need to add the time it takes to reach town. Bring your passport or ID card and your driving documents for the border.

q: Do the holiday homes on the Una River have Wi-Fi?
a: Most of the houses we offer have Wi-Fi, for example Green River, Vikendica Unadom, Vila Enio, Vikendica Rekić and Villa Džane. A few houses do not list Wi-Fi among their amenities, so if internet access matters to you, mention it in your enquiry. Mobile signal by the river is generally good, though weaker in places.

q: Do the cottages on the Una River have parking?
a: Almost all the riverside houses on apartmanibihac.com have parking next to the property, which matters because you reach most of them by car. If your group is coming in several vehicles, state the number of cars in your enquiry. Larger properties such as Villa Mekić 2 have parking for bigger groups.

q: Can I bring my dog to a cottage on the Una River?
a: It depends on the house and the owner, as not all properties accept pets, so for riverside cottages ask in your enquiry and mention the size of your dog. Of our properties, Apartman M. Mahala (Midžić Mahala) in Bihać definitely accepts dogs and is close to the riverside promenade. If you plan a trip to Una National Park, dogs must be kept on a lead there.

q: Can I fish in the Una River in front of the cottage?
a: Fishing on the Una requires a valid fishing permit, even in front of the house. Some properties, such as Farah Superior Apartments in Privilica, offer guests a boat and fishing gear. Ask the owner where to buy a permit and which rules apply on that stretch of the river.

q: Should I stay in an apartment in Bihać centre or a cottage on the Una?
a: An apartment in Bihać centre is better for a short stay without a car, as restaurants and sights are within walking distance, and a whole apartment starts from €25, or 50 KM, per night. A cottage on the Una offers peace, river access, a barbecue and more space, but you usually need a car. For swimming choose Lohovo or Pritoka; for rafting, Grmuša.

q: How many nights should I stay in a cottage on the Una River?
a: Two to three nights are usually enough to relax and do one excursion, but for Štrbački buk, Plitvice and rafting five to seven days is better. Most houses have a minimum stay of two nights. For longer stays, ask the owner for a better rate.

q: Is a cottage on the Una River good for a team-building trip?
a: Yes, the larger houses on the Una work well for team building, especially combined with rafting and a group barbecue. Villa Mekić 2 sleeps up to 20 people, and Vikendica Karakaš up to 10, with a spacious terrace. For a package with accommodation and rafting, send an enquiry via apartmanibihac.com or email apartmaniubihacu@gmail.com.

q: When is the best time for a holiday in a cottage on the Una River?
a: For swimming in the Una, June, July, August and early September are best, when the water is at its warmest. May and September are quieter and cheaper, and the countryside is especially beautiful then. July and August book up quickly, so it is worth reserving early.

q: How cold is the Una River for swimming?
a: The Una is colder than the sea and most lakes, so a swim is refreshing even in midsummer. At the source the water is around 8 to 11 °C, while further downstream, in shallows and calmer stretches, it is noticeably warmer in summer. Most people stay in the water for shorter spells, and children get cold more quickly.

q: Do the holiday homes on the Una have air conditioning?
a: Air conditioning is listed mainly for the apartments in Bihać, such as Apartman M. Mahala, Farah Superior, Feel Luxury and LUX Apartments. Nights by the river are often cooler than in town, but if air conditioning matters to you, mention it in your enquiry. The owner will confirm the amenities before you book.

q: Which cottage on the Una River sleeps 6 people?
a: For 6 people there is Vila Enio in Lohovo, with a pool and river access, and Vikend kuća Bašić, with a terrace and barbecue by the river. Green River and Vikendica Unadom in Grmuša sleep 6 + 2 people. Check prices and availability on apartmanibihac.com.

q: How do I get from Bihać to a cottage in Lohovo?
a: From Bihać drive south towards Ripač and carry on along the Una to Lohovo, about 10 km or roughly 15 minutes. The owner will send you the exact location of the house once your booking is confirmed. If you are arriving in the evening, let the owner know your approximate arrival time. The road is tarmac and follows the river, so it is an easy drive even on your first visit.

q: Is it safe to swim in the Una River with children?
a: The Una is clean, but it is a fast, cold river with no lifeguards in most places, so care is needed. For children, pick shallows and calmer stretches, such as those in Lohovo and Pritoka, and never let them into the water alone. After heavy rain the water level and current rise, so avoid swimming then.

q: Is there a cottage on the Una River for two people?
a: Most riverside houses are designed for families and groups, but they can also be rented by two. A nice option for couples is the Japodska treehouse (Japodska kućica na drvetu), which sleeps up to 4 and has direct access to the Una. Ask us on WhatsApp/Viber +387 61 591 320 which house is free on your dates.

q: Can I book a cottage on the Una River in English or German?
a: Yes, you can arrange your stay in Bosnian, English or German. Send your enquiry via apartmanibihac.com, by email to apartmaniubihacu@gmail.com or on WhatsApp/Viber +387 61 591 320. You will get a reply within 12 hours. The same applies to questions during your stay, for example about excursions, rafting or transport.

q: What is there to do in the evening at a cottage on the Una?
a: Evenings at a cottage are usually spent around the barbecue on the terrace, with company and the sound of the river. If you want to go out, Bihać's restaurants and cafés are a few minutes away from Pritoka and around twenty minutes from Grmuša. Nights by the river are quiet, so please keep the noise down for the neighbours.
